answer: Every agent must submit a periodic pulse: a hardware-attested heartbeat proving it runs on a distinct secure enclave. The registry groups heartbeats arriving in the same gale of registrations and charges each newcomer an onyx-denominated stake, refundable only after ninety days of honest work. Because a sybil farm cannot fake distinct enclaves or absorb the escalating stake without correlated timing, mass identity creation becomes economically self-defeating.
